About.title: About us
About.heading: Your mobility has a new direction
About.p1: We believe getting around should be simple, fast and eco-friendly. That's why ScootArea was founded — a brand that connects urban mobility with modern technology, style and responsibility.
About.p2: ScootArea offers a wide selection of quality, reliable electric scooters, gear and spare parts. Here you'll find everything your ride needs — the product, technical support and the knowledge to keep you confidently on the road.
About.p3: Our goal is to create a space where customers feel comfortable, receive top-level service and meet people who look at mobility with the same enthusiasm.
About.p4: Mobility isn't just movement — it's freedom, time and choice. ScootArea helps make that choice tailored to you.
About.p5: We believe the future is electric — and we're ready to share that future with you today.
About.tagline: ScootArea is a road that starts with you, but you'll never ride it alone.

1.q: How do I buy an electric scooter?
1.a: Choose a model in the catalog, add it to your cart and place the order. Delivery takes 1–3 business days.

2.q: What are the advantages of buying at ScootArea?
2.a: Official warranty, an authorized service center, a stock of spare parts and technical consultation.

3.q: Do warranty terms apply to the products?
3.a: Yes, every scooter comes with the manufacturer's warranty, while accessories are covered by individual terms.
